name: Low-Level Research Lab
description: Research and recovery transports below fastboot. EDL (Qualcomm 9008 emergency download) via firehose, EUD (Qualcomm/Apple emergency USB download), QDL (the open firehose loader), and Hexagon DSP image work. Each transport has a different protocol, a different tool, and a different way to brick the device.
